item.title: Any attempt to block Strait of Hormuz would trigger American retaliation, Trump warns Iran
item.description: Washington: US President Donald Trump centred his latest warning to Iran on the Strait of Hormuz, saying any attempt to block or disrupt the vital oil route would trigger overwhelming American retaliation. “If Iran does anything that stops the flow of Oil within the Strait of Hormuz, they will be hit by the United States of America TWENTY TIMES HARDER than they have been hit thus far,” Trump said in a statement posted on Truth Social. item.description: Washington: President Donald Trump said he held a “very good” call with Russian President Vladimir Putin, discussing the Ukraine war and the escalating conflict in the Middle East as the United States continues military operations against Iran. item.title: WHO Plans Survey to Check Lead Presence in Turmeric Produced in Odisha
item.description: Bhubaneswar: The World Health Organisation (WHO) has expressed concern over the possible presence of lead in turmeric produced in Odisha. The organisation has initiated discussions with the state Health Department to conduct sample testing and determine the actual level of lead presence. If the state government approves the proposal, a detailed survey will be carried out in Odisha to examine turmeric samples. item.title: Odisha: Rayagada bike crash leaves three dead, two critical
item.description: Rayagada: In a tragic mishap, at least three persons lost their lives and two others were critically injured after two motorcycles collided head-on in Bissamcuttack in Odisha's Rayagada district on Monday.The accident took place near roadside dhaba close to Durgi village late in the night. item.title: Fake Robbery Claim Uncovered in Odisha's Rayagada; Accountant Detained
item.description: Rayagada: Police in Odisha's Rayagada have cracked a suspected robbery case within 12 hours of receiving the complaint and detained the accused after finding that the incident was staged. According to police, Akshaya Bibar, manager of Patra Electronics, informed Rayagada police station on the phone yesterday afternoon that the firm’s accountant, Ranjit Kumar Dalai, had been robbed while on his way to deposit cash at the SBI. item.title: NCERT withdraws Class 8 textbook after row over judiciary chapter, issues public apology
item.description: New Delhi: The National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) on Tuesday issued a public apology over a chapter in its Class 8 Social Science textbook titled 'Exploring Society: India and Beyond' (Grade 8, Part II), which contained a section on the judiciary. The council also announced that the entire book has been withdrawn and is no longer available. item.title: 54 communal riots across Odisha in last 20 months: CM Mohan Majhi
item.description: Bhubaneswar: As many as 54 communal riots were registered across different districts of Odisha between June 2024 and February 2026, informed Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Monday. item.title: Odisha: Youth’s death over ‘police harassment’ allegation triggers massive protest
item.description: Puri: Tension flared as irate villagers stated a protest following the death of a youth over alleged police harassment in Nimapara in Odisha's Puri district here today. The deceased, identified as Subrata Bhoi was a resident of Dihabari area under Nimapara. He was found hanging from a tree in a village field in the morning. item.title: Employee Found Hanging in Employer’s Office in Rourkela, Probe Underway
item.description: Rourkela: The body of a 35-year-old man was found hanging under suspicious circumstances inside his employer’s office at the NAC New Market near Panposh Square in Rourkela on Tuesday. The deceased has been identified as Ashwini Kumar Barik, a resident of Sector-6 C Block. Police said the exact cause of death is yet to be determined. item.title: India invokes Essential Commodities Act to ensure uninterrupted LPG supply
item.description: New Delhi: As hotels and restaurants report commercial LPG shortage, the government has invoked the Essential Commodities (EC) Act to ensure the uninterrupted supply of domestic cooking gas, directing refineries and petrochemical units to maximise the production of LPG.
